narrative.overview: Ship Log borrows its visual grammar from the pages developers read every day without thinking of them as "design": GitHub Releases, npm and crates.io package pages, changelog files. A post is treated like an entry in a log — dated, tagged, badge-labeled — rather than a magazine feature with a hero image and a pull-quote. The system refuses two AI-generated-blog clichés on sight: the warm-cream-paper-plus-serif-display look, and the broadsheet-editorial-hairline-plus-italic look. Instead it stays strictly monochrome with one blue, lets hairline rules do the structural work cards and shadows usually do, and treats monospace type as the system's "label language" — the tell that something is metadata rather than prose. Density is calm, not dense: one changelog-style row per post, generous vertical rhythm, no card grid. The three-column article reading layout is preserved and restyled in the same grammar rather than replaced — this is still a reading product first.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline rules and outlined badges instead of cards, shadows, and filled pills.
Space Grotesk for all prose and headings; Space Mono exclusively for machine-set metadata.
ISO-shaped dates (2026-03-05) instead of prose dates.
Exactly one accent color, used only for interactive/active state.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one hue in this system. Express a second idea as weight, outline, or glyph, never a second color.

rules.name: The Two-Blue Rule
rules.body: --color-brand is for text/rings/outlines and shifts per theme. --color-brand-solid is for anything a white-text fill sits under, and is fixed across both themes.

rules.name: The System-Voice Rule
rules.body: Text describing the system (dates, counts, tags, nav labels) is set in Space Mono; text that is the writing stays in Space Grotesk.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a soft shadow. Depth and state are hairlines, outlines, and inset accent bars.

dos: Do set every date as date.toLocaleDateString("en-CA") for a YYYY-MM-DD changelog timestamp.
Do put any new metadata in Space Mono, following The System-Voice Rule.
Do keep new list/archive UI in the single-column changelog-row pattern.
Do cap prose line length explicitly with a ch-based max-width.
donts: Don't add a second accent color or a filled/colored badge background.
Don't reintroduce box-shadow as a soft/blurred effect anywhere.
Don't use --color-brand as a fill under white text; use --color-brand-solid.
Don't collapse the article's three-column layout on desktop, and don't place a tracked kicker label as its own line above an h1.
Don't replace Space Grotesk with a display/novelty face.
